servinfo.title: Passenger Air Bag Deactivation Switch Inspection (If Equipped)

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Passenger Air Bag Deactivation Indicator Removal and Installation (If Equipped)

s1.ptxt: Remove passenger air bag deactivation switch.
Measure resistance between terminals “1” and “2” at air bag ON position and OFF position.

spec.title: Passenger air bag deactivation switch resistance

s1.ptxt: While measuring resistance, move passenger air bag deactivation switch lightly and check that resistance does not change.
If measured resistance is not as specified or fluctuates, replace passenger air bag deactivation switch.
